events.title: WET FELTED BOWL WORKSHOP
events.description: WET FELTED BOWL WORKSHOP FOR ADULTS Saturday 12 September 2026 9.30am - 1.30pm Join Agnès to learn how to wet felt a bowl using colourful merino silk blends and corriedale wool in a private location in Mullumbimby. Including choice of wool colour + GF generous morning tea. Complete beginners welcome. Min 6 participants - Max 8 participants. Cost:
